assertion: A zero-width backdrop has no pixels to filter but still isolates its overflowing foreground. The multiply-only control sees the blue page, while the filtered control keeps the original green.

browser.reason: Chrome retains isolation even when the backdrop filter region has zero width. Valle matches both controls exactly. Firefox omits filtering; WebKit also differs on the zero-width multiply-only control. See ../backdrop-blend/README.md; no pixel allowance.
